TYPE CHECK: The candidate value "jejunal crypt cells" describes a specific cell type/population, which matches the field definition.
SOURCE CHECK: The paper mentions "Jejunal crypt cells were isolated, and transcriptome sequence was performed", but this refers to RNA sequencing, not mass spectrometry. The actual mass spectrometry (MS) experiment is described in the "Biotin-coupled probe pulldown assay" section, where "The RNA pulldown products were also analyzed by mass spectrometry." These products were derived from "circDmbt1(3,4,5,6)-overexpressing 293 T cells" (used for RNA extraction) and "crypts... extracted from a healthy mouse for protein extraction."
TRUTH CHECK: While "jejunal crypt cells" are mentioned in the context of RNA-seq, the MS experiment specifically used proteins extracted from "crypts" of a healthy mouse. "Jejunal crypt cells" is a reasonable description of the cells within those crypts.
COMPLETENESS CHECK: The full set only contains "jejunal crypt cells", but it misses the other MS sample source: the 293 T cell line.
